messages:
Rhea: OK new personal record: Olive did the slowest, most judging blink and then tucked into the window hammock like a tiny loaf. photo drop. :heart_eyes_cat: :hammock:
Ethan: i can hear the tiny judge blink. legendary. post the clip pls. :joy:
Sofia: that face says 'i accept your offering of kibble, peasant.' :crown:
Olive: i trained her for this. 3 treats and a motivational pep talk. low-effort, high-return. :trophy:
upload-bot: Uploaded image: https://cdn.redwoodusercontent.com/media/olive_hammock_loaf_2026-03-23.jpg (thumb) [file:olive_hammock_2026.jpg]
Rhea: also recorded a 4s loop where she dramatically flicks an ear at the sunlight. thinking of making it a slack emoji. any objections?
Ethan: none. approve emoji. :thumbsup:
Sofia: approve. request: add tiny crown overlay and call it :olive-judge:
Olive: ordering tiny crown stickers right now. will prototype tomorrow and report back with terrible photoshop attempts. :sparkles:
Rhea: thank you for the very important update. morale +10.
